_comment: Fedora package map for the caelestia Hyprland image. Every entry was verified against a live Fedora 44 container on 2026-10-14. `build.py audit` re-verifies every one of these before the image is built.

cops.for: already enabled by the wayblue base image (hyprlock/hypridle/hyprpaper/hyprpicker/xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland)

packages.note: requested as the login shell
NOT in the wayblue base image despite its recipe listing it; caelestia's default 'thunar' component themes ~/.config/gtk-3.0/thunar.css, so it must be present
VANILLA - caelestia's fastfetch config is deliberately NOT deployed
from the wayblue COPR
needs /dev/uinput + evdev - see udev rules
Fedora name for Arch's 'adw-gtk-theme'
Fedora equivalent of ttf-jetbrains-mono-nerd (not nerd-patched)
Fedora equivalent of ttf-cascadia-code-nerd (not nerd-patched)
Fedora equivalent of noto-fonts-emoji
Fedora equivalent of noto-fonts
Fedora equivalent of noto-fonts-cjk (note: 'sans-cjk')
shell clock/workspaces font; absent from Fedora
RUNTIME lib for the caelestia plugins (libqalculate.so.23). Was only a build dep - plugins failed to load without it.
RUNTIME lib for the caelestia services plugin (libaubio.so.5). Was only a build dep.
RUNTIME lib for the quickshell binary (libjemalloc.so.2). Was only a build dep.
polkit auth agent; substitutes Arch's polkit-gnome which does not exist on Fedora
runtime dep of gpu-screen-recorder; Fedora renamed ffmpeg-libs -> ffmpeg-free
polkit-gnome no longer exists in Fedora 44. The dots exec /usr/lib/polkit-gnome/polkit-gnome-authentication-agent-1, so the image ships a shim that execs this agent.
the dots exec /usr/lib/geoclue-2.0/demos/agent for location services.
Volume control for the Ctrl+Alt+V bind. pwvucontrol (upstream's choice) does not exist in Fedora 44; pavucontrol does and is the equivalent PulseAudio/PipeWire mixer.
editor; `nvim` is not a Fedora package, it is `neovim`.
GPT partition tooling; not in the base image.
disk health monitoring; not in the base image.
ext filesystem tools; already in the base, listed for documentation.
core utilities; already in the base, listed for documentation.
disk usage analyzer with a TUI; complements du/duf.
modern disk usage/free utility; nicer than df.
continuous file synchronization; layered here so it survives rebases.

not_in_base_by_design.rofi-wayland: listed in wayblue's recipe but not actually installed; caelestia uses fuzzel + its own launcher, so this is not needed
not_in_base_by_design.thunar: wayblue's recipe lists it but it is absent from the published image - we install it ourselves because caelestia themes it
not_in_base_by_design.power-profiles-daemon: DELIBERATELY NOT INSTALLED. The wayblue base already ships tuned-ppd, which declares 'Conflicts: power-profiles-daemon' because both provide the ppd-service unit. The shell does not need the power-profiles-daemon binary: it uses Quickshell's PowerProfiles QML module, which talks the org.freedesktop.PowerProfiles D-Bus interface that tuned-ppd also implements. Installing both makes the dnf transaction fail outright.

remove_from_base.why: wayblue's waybar config; caelestia ships its own bar and would render a duplicate
wayblue's Hyprland plugin lua; caelestia ships hypr/hyprland.lua. User config at ~/.config/hypr wins regardless, so this is only removed to avoid confusion.

env_overrides.why: wayblue sets QT_STYLE_OVERRIDE=adwaita-dark and GTK_THEME=Adwaita:dark. QT_STYLE_OVERRIDE forces the Adwaita Qt style and SILENTLY BYPASSES caelestia's qtengine theming entirely.

build_deps._note: only needed inside the builder container, never shipped in the image. Mirrors builder/Containerfile.
build_deps._no_dart: Dart is deliberately NOT installed: no Dart SDK is packaged for Fedora 44 and bootstrapping one from source is a multi-hour chicken-and-egg build. dart-sass is consumed as the official Sass-team release binary pinned against GitHub's first-party sha256 digest.
